name: Stefanie Gates
summary: Social worker and correctional counselor at the Leonida Department of Corrections, seen questioning Lucia during her incarceration.
description: Stefanie Gates is the first speaking character introduced in the debut trailer of Grand Theft Auto VI. Seated behind a secure desk at the Leonida Department of Corrections with her nameplate visible, Stefanie asks Lucia if she understands why she is in prison, to which Lucia pragmatically replies, 'Bad luck, I guess.' Her role bridges Lucia's prison background to her eventual return to Vice City's criminal underworld.
personality: Observant, professional, skeptical, empathetic yet firm.
